schema.description: Administrative evaluation request. The concrete target and spend client are explicit, including client context for aggregate agent evaluation.

target.description: Concrete organization, user, or agent and spend client to evaluate.

x-enumDescriptions.ORGANIZATION: Shared limit across the organization for the selected spend client.
x-enumDescriptions.DEFAULT_USER: Default per-user limit for the selected spend client.
x-enumDescriptions.DEFAULT_AGENT: Default aggregate limit applied to agents without an agent-specific limit.
x-enumDescriptions.USER: Limit for one user, identified by canonical user ID or email, and the selected spend client.
x-enumDescriptions.AGENT: Aggregate limit for one canonical agent ID, independent of spend client.
x-enumDescriptions.IDP_GROUP: Response-only source of an inherited per-user IdP-group limit.
x-enumDescriptions.DEPARTMENT: Response-only source of an inherited per-user department limit.

x-speakeasy-enum-descriptions.ORGANIZATION: Shared limit across the organization for the selected spend client.
x-speakeasy-enum-descriptions.DEFAULT_USER: Default per-user limit for the selected spend client.
x-speakeasy-enum-descriptions.DEFAULT_AGENT: Default aggregate limit applied to agents without an agent-specific limit.
x-speakeasy-enum-descriptions.USER: Limit for one user, identified by canonical user ID or email, and the selected spend client.
x-speakeasy-enum-descriptions.AGENT: Aggregate limit for one canonical agent ID, independent of spend client.
x-speakeasy-enum-descriptions.IDP_GROUP: Response-only source of an inherited per-user IdP-group limit.
x-speakeasy-enum-descriptions.DEPARTMENT: Response-only source of an inherited per-user department limit.

client_id.description: Opaque, case-sensitive spend-client ID, such as glean or an external gateway spend-client ID. Case and leading or trailing padding are preserved exactly; this is not inferred from the authenticating OAuth application, prefixed, or normalized. Empty and whitespace-only IDs (including Unicode whitespace), synthetic UI aggregation IDs, and control characters are invalid. Unknown IDs are valid and can have no applicable configured policies. Required for ORGANIZATION, DEFAULT_USER, and USER configurations; forbidden for configured aggregate DEFAULT_AGENT and AGENT policies. Evaluation always requires a concrete client, including for agents. The reserved * client is valid only for the Phase 1 DEFAULT_USER actions-only premium policy, not a cross-client budget or evaluation client. Omission never selects Glean or acts as a wildcard.

user_id.description: Canonical user ID; valid only when type is USER. A USER target requires user_id, email, or both.

email.description: Email address of the user, including a known alias email; valid only when type is USER. Matching is case-insensitive and resolves to the canonical user_id. When user_id is also supplied, both must identify the same user. Email is never part of the stored limit key. Responses include the user's directory email when one is available.

agent_id.description: Canonical agent ID; required only when type is AGENT.

target.title: PlatformUsageTarget

x-enumDescriptions.RECURRING_CALENDAR_MONTH: Resets at the start of each calendar month.

x-speakeasy-enum-descriptions.RECURRING_CALENDAR_MONTH: Resets at the start of each calendar month.

target.description: Concrete target and explicit spend-client context.

client_id.description: Concrete evaluation client, never the wildcard policy key.
